basis: Douglas Dynamics publicly established the decline by October 30, 2023. Its consolidated income statement reports Q3 GAAP net sales of $144,121,000 against $166,100,000 for the same three months of 2022, down 13.23% and below the $157,795,000 cutoff. The upper_bound is the verified actual. The earliest date remains open because the full May, August and September presentation contents and any public September conference remarks could not be verified.

coverage.detail: The preceding year-end release introduced a $620 million to $680 million FY2023 net-sales range. It gave no consolidated Q3 ceiling.
The April 17 preliminary results covered Q1. Management reduced the annual outlook and anticipated weaker preseason demand without quantifying consolidated Q3 sales.
The May 1 Q1 release gave a $620 million to $650 million full-year range. Its preseason warning concerned Work Truck Attachments.

The issuer’s May 2 earnings event linked to this webcast player. It returned an empty page in the retrieval tool, with no verifiable audio or transcript. The April 25 shareholder-meeting player at https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/v6nzw5ue also failed to load.

In the secondary May 2 call transcript, the CFO discussed lower volume at 17:43 and identified the $620 million to $650 million figure as annual guidance at 18:36. Neither passage supplied a consolidated Q3 sales ceiling.

On July 31, management expected roughly a 60/40 Q2/Q3 split of Attachments preseason revenue. The split excluded Solutions and had no firm endpoint. Subtracting first-half sales of $289.812 million from the reiterated annual outlook implies $330.188 million to $360.188 million for Q3 and Q4 combined. It leaves Q3 unresolved.

The August 1 event page at https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/news-events/ir-calendar/detail/7696/second-quarter-2023-earnings failed to load. The financial-results archive independently identified the official Q2 replay at https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/8rk5jgsj. That player also failed to load. The issuer had advertised a one-week replay.

The secondary August 1 transcript confirms that an analyst proposed a more Q2-weighted split, including 70/30. The CFO answered in terms of Attachments volumes across the preseason. That exchange supplied no management ceiling for consolidated Q3 dollars.

This inventory and https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/NYSE-PLOW/documents/ both list May 16 and August 10 investor presentations. Neither retrieved listing exposed the slide contents. The issuer’s https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/news-events/presentations did not supply either historical deck.

Moody’s specifically identifies and illustrates Douglas Dynamics’ August 2023 investor materials. The reproduced material concerns snowfall and financial performance. It confirms the deck existed but covers only part of it.
The archive lookup for 2023 issuer-hosted PDFs was inaccessible. It yielded no recoverable May or August deck.

The September EX-99.1 contains 20 linked slide images. The SEC submission records acceptance September 20 at 08:58:10. Direct image retrieval did not yield a readable full deck, including at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1287213/000143774923026432/pic14.jpg. The issuer-mirrored image also failed.

The issuer copy identifies the September 18 deck and its intended use at D.A. Davidson’s September 20–22 conference. PDF text extraction ended at the exhibit heading, and a page-image request failed. September 18 is the deck date. The filing establishes public availability by September 20.

The host’s conference directory, targeted searches for the 22nd annual event, and the issuer calendar at https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/news-events/ir-calendar/past yielded no retrievable Douglas Dynamics recording or transcript. The content of any public remarks remains unverified.

Between the July 31 and October 30 results releases, the issuer archive lists the September 6 dividend declaration and October 17 call notice. It timestamps the Q3 results at 6:00 p.m. EDT on October 30.
Page 8 gives 144,121 and 166,100 in thousands on the same consolidated net-sales row for the three months ended September 30, 2023 and 2022. Both periods use the reported companywide perimeter.
Item 2.02 identifies the second October 31 exhibit as supplemental slides for that morning’s earnings call and explicitly refers to results already announced.

publication_date_evidence: The October 30 dateline in the results exhibit and the issuer archive’s October 30, 2023, 6:00 p.m. EDT timestamp verify publication before the October 31 filings. The unresolved earlier presentations prevent assigning that verified release date as the earliest qualifying disclosure.
